+title: Carry the contributing layer directories and their grants on the catalog entry
+---
+## What
+
+The catalog entry of `SkillsRegistry` (`Sources/FoundationModelsSkills/Registry/SkillsRegistry.swift:519`) holds one `skillDirectory`, one `winningLayer` and one `grants`. With the combined view a skill has more than one layer directory, and a file can come from a layer that is not the layer of `SKILL.md`.
+
+1. The entry holds `contributingDirectories` (the value that `DiscoveredSkill` now gives), lowest precedence first.
+2. The entry holds the layer and the marketplace grants **of each** contributing directory, not of the winning `SKILL.md` only. The later resource cards use this to apply the grants of the layer that gives the file.
+3. `winningLayer` stays. It is the layer of `SKILL.md`, and `StencilPass` keeps it for the trust of the render and for the scope of the partials.
+4. The validator (`Sources/FoundationModelsSkills/Validation/SkillValidator.swift`) reads the winning `SKILL.md` as it does now. No change of rule.
+
+## Acceptance Criteria
+
+- [ ] A catalog entry gives the ordered contributing directories, each with its layer and its grants.
+- [ ] `winningLayer` still names the layer of `SKILL.md`, and the trust of the render does not change.
+- [ ] A skill that has one layer directory only behaves exactly as before.
+- [ ] `swift build --build-tests` gives 0 warnings, and `swift test` is green.
+
+## Tests
+
+- [ ] `Tests/FoundationModelsSkillsTests/SkillsRegistryTests.swift`: a skill that two layers give has two contributing directories in the entry, lowest first.
+- [ ] Same file: a marketplace layer below a local layer gives its own grants on its own contributing directory, and the local directory has no grants.
+- [ ] `swift test` — all tests pass, 0 failures.
+
+## Workflow
+- Use `/tdd` — write failing tests first, then implement to make them pass.
+

+

Each element gives `rootIndex`, `root` and `skillDirectory`. `SkillDiscovery.discoveredSkill(id:holdingLayers:in:)` always fills the list, lowest precedence first, and `rootIndex` indexes the same layer array that `SkillsRegistry.LayerPlan.layers` holds.
+    - `SkillsRegistry.CatalogEntry` (private) holds `skillDirectory` and `winningLayer`. `buildCatalog(plan:)` makes each entry with `plan.layers[discovered.rootIndex]`. The map from a contributing directory to its layer is therefore `plan.layers[contributing.rootIndex]`.

+    - `SkillsRegistry(layers:)` takes `DotfolderStack.Layer` values directly, so a test can put a `.marketplace` layer below a `.user` layer.
+
+    ### Conflict with a newer card
+
+    Acceptance criterion "No field of the entry names a grant" overlaps card ^8mxhn6a ("Remove the marketplace grant concept: one host policy for every layer"), item 4 of which owns the delete of `grants` from `CatalogEntry`, of `grants(atLayerIndex:)` and of `effectivePolicy(for:)`.
